caption: The drawing depicts a lidded urn or trophy-shaped object standing on a square base. The urn is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance, and it has a smooth, reflective surface. The body of the urn is elongated and curves smoothly at the bottom to a narrower stem, which then widens again where it meets the base. The lid fits snugly on top of the urn and has a pronounced curve, topped with an ornamental finial resembling a stylized pineapple. There is a decorative, engraved pattern or monogram on the front side of the urn. The object is centered on a plain, untextured background with no other items or details visible around it.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
